remarks: Fresh, light and clean with a like new feeling. Extensive list of updates and additions to this already darling in - town home. Fully painted interior including kitchen and bath cabinets, extensive new shiplap millwork and new mudroom built-ins. New refrigerator, new quartz counter tops in kitchen , new washer and dryer , and new window treatments . Large bedrooms with oversized closets . Full basement with great storage. New landscaping (landscaping maintenance included in rental price ),sweet side patio and green fenced in yard space. Live on the best ,most convenient , street in New Canaan. Train ,shopping, fine dining ,all that New Canaan has to offer is steps away.
